hero_copy.label: Hero introduction
hero_copy.value: I'm Haley Reeder, an instructional designer, but what that really means is I'm a learning design and development strategist focused on sales and partner enablement for complex products. I don't just make content. I build and maintain learning experiences from scope and design through delivery, LMS operations, and analytics. I use new tools and approaches when they solve a real problem while grounding the work in proven learning principles.

featured_intro.label: Featured work introduction
featured_intro.value: Browse projects across instructional design, AI evaluation, LMS administration, and workflow automation.

hero_intro_primary.label: Experience summary
hero_intro_primary.value: My work began in high-school classrooms and K–12 curriculum, where I learned to design for access, challenge, and learner agency. I bring that foundation to enterprise learning, AI quality, learning platforms, and live facilitation.

hero_intro.value: My work centers on enterprise learning for sellers and partners, with additional projects in AI evaluation, LMS operations, reporting, and automation.

hero_intro.label: Hero introduction
hero_intro.value: I turn complex product, sales, and operational knowledge into learning that helps sellers and partners recognize customer signals, make stronger decisions, and act with confidence.

overview_heading.label: Overview heading
overview_heading.value: I design the full path from source material to on-the-job action.

overview_body_one.label: Overview paragraph
overview_body_one.value: I start with the learner decision, build the right scaffold of context and practice, then deliver it through the channels that make sense: courses, live sessions, performance support, and the LMS. I keep the work connected as the content, audience, and business need change.

examples_intro.label: Examples introduction
examples_intro.value: Browse by the learning decision or delivery format, then open the deeper examples to see the design, development, and delivery choices behind the work.

hero_intro_primary.label: Hero introduction
hero_intro_primary.value: I build evaluation systems that make AI quality visible: frame the job, choose the right evaluation lens, apply clear rubrics, calibrate judgment, and turn findings into useful next steps.

overview_heading.label: Overview heading
overview_heading.value: From observation to a defensible decision.

overview_body_one.label: Overview paragraph 1
overview_body_one.value: A reliable evaluation program gives reviewers one traceable path: define the question, apply the standard, capture the evidence, explain the judgment, and compare it with a benchmark.

overview_body_two.label: Overview paragraph 2
overview_body_two.value: Choose a pipeline stage to see the evidence, rationale, and reviewer action that make each decision traceable.

hero_title.label: Hero title
hero_title.value: Workflows that keep learning work moving.

hero_intro.label: Hero introduction
hero_intro.value: Learning work depends on connected requests, reviews, files, launch steps, and updates. I design those handoffs so teams can see what happens next and keep the work usable over time.

areas_heading.label: Workflow areas heading
areas_heading.value: How requests, reviews, publishing, and upkeep stay connected.

areas_intro.label: Workflow areas introduction
areas_intro.value: Courses and resources only help when people can request them, build them, review them, find them, and update them. Workflow design is the foundation that keeps those actions coordinated.

hero_intro.label: Contact hero introduction
hero_intro.value: GitHub or LinkedIn are the easiest ways to reach me. I’m always interested in thoughtful conversations about instructional design, learning technology, AI, enablement, and learning systems work.
